title: Appendectomy
synopsis: A doctor explains appendix removal surgery to an anxious patient.

series.title: Medicine and Healthcare in Everyday Life

fullText.simplified:
阑尾炎手术

医生：根据您目前的情况，可以确诊为阑尾炎，建议您进行手术，切除发炎部分。
患者：要做手术吗？医生，我很紧张，因为我从来没有接受过手术。
医生：我理解您的紧张。手术确实是一件重要的事情。您将接受的是阑尾切除手术，这是一种常规手术，技术上已经非常成熟了。
患者：您能解释一下手术的过程吗？
医生：当然可以。手术的开始，麻醉师会给您进行全身麻醉，麻醉后您在整个手术过程中将不会有任何感觉。然后，我将在您的腹部进行穿刺孔，以便插入手术器械和摄像头。摄像头将帮助我清楚地看到您的阑尾，并进行切除。整个手术大约需要一个小时。
患者：好的，我什么时候手术比较好？
医生：越快越好。从血液检查结果和影像检查结果来看，您的身体条件可以进行手术，明天就可以安排。
患者：好的。我需要住院吗？
医生：要住院，虽然阑尾炎手术的风险比较低，不过有一些患者会出现麻醉反应或者术后感染。你最好在医院观察两天，如果没有其他问题就可以出院了。
患者：好的，我请我的家人来陪我。
医生：可以，你们先去办理一下住院手续，今天晚上九点以后就不要吃东西和喝水了。
患者：还有其他需要注意的事情吗？
医生：可以让家人给你准备一些液体的食物。术后的一两天内要卧床休息，少吃东西，吃点儿液体食物保持体力就可以了。之后的几天不要剧烈运动，防止手术的伤口裂开。然后需要保持伤口干燥，定期消毒就可以了。
患者：好的，谢谢您。我先去办住院手续了。
医生：好的！
fullText.traditional:
闌尾炎手術

醫生：根據您目前的情況，可以確診為闌尾炎，建議您進行手術，切除發炎部分。
患者：要做手術嗎？醫生，我很緊張，因為我從來沒有接受過手術。
醫生：我理解您的緊張。手術確實是一件重要的事情。您將接受的是闌尾切除手術，這是一種常規手術，技術上已經非常成熟了。
患者：您能解釋一下手術的過程嗎？
醫生：當然可以。手術的開始，麻醉師會給您進行全身麻醉，麻醉後您在整個手術過程中將不會有任何感覺。然後，我將在您的腹部進行穿刺孔，以便插入手術器械和攝像頭。攝像頭將幫助我清楚地看到您的闌尾，並進行切除。整個手術大約需要一個小時。
患者：好的，我什麼時候手術比較好？
醫生：越快越好。從血液檢查結果和影像檢查結果來看，您的身體條件可以進行手術，明天就可以安排。
患者：好的。我需要住院嗎？
醫生：要住院，雖然闌尾炎手術的風險比較低，不過有一些患者會出現麻醉反應或者術後感染。你最好在醫院觀察兩天，如果沒有其他問題就可以出院了。
患者：好的，我請我的家人來陪我。
醫生：可以，你們先去辦理一下住院手續，今天晚上九點以後就不要吃東西和喝水了。
患者：還有其他需要注意的事情嗎？
醫生：可以讓家人給你準備一些液體的食物。術後的一兩天內要臥床休息，少吃東西，吃點兒液體食物保持體力就可以了。之後的幾天不要劇烈運動，防止手術的傷口裂開。然後需要保持傷口乾燥，定期消毒就可以了。
患者：好的，謝謝您。我先去辦住院手續了。
醫生：好的！

I recommend you to undergo surgery to remove the inflamed part.

sentences.english: Doctor: I understand your anxiety. Surgery is indeed an significant matter.
You will be undergoing an appendectomy, which is a routine procedure and is technically very mature.

sentences.simplified: 患者：您能解释一下手术的过程吗？
sentences.traditional: 患者：您能解釋一下手術的過程嗎？
sentences.pinyin: huàn zhě nín néng jiě shì yí xià shǒu shù de guò chéng ma

sentences.english: Patient: Can you explain the surgery procedure?

sentences.simplified: 医生：当然可以。
sentences.traditional: 醫生：當然可以。
sentences.pinyin: yī shēng dāng rán kě yǐ

sentences.pinyin: shǒu shù de kāi shǐ má zuì shī huì gěi nín jìn xíng quán shēn má zuì
sentences.english: Doctor: Of course I can.

sentences.simplified: 麻醉后您在整个手术过程中将不会有任何感觉。

sentences.english: At the start of the surgery, the anesthetist will administer general anesthesia.

sentences.simplified: 然后，我将在您的腹部进行穿刺孔，以便插入手术器械和摄像头。
sentences.traditional: 然後，我將在您的腹部進行穿刺孔，以便插入手術器械和攝像頭。
sentences.pinyin: rán hòu wǒ jiāng zài nín de fù bù jìn xíng chuān cì kǒng yǐ biàn chā rù shǒu shù qì xiè hé shè xiàng tóu
sentences.english: After anesthesia, you will not feel anything during the entire surgery process.

sentences.simplified: 摄像头将帮助我清楚地看到您的阑尾，并进行切除。整个手术大约需要一个小时。
sentences.traditional: 攝像頭將幫助我清楚地看到您的闌尾，並進行切除。整個手術大約需要一個小時。
sentences.pinyin: shè xiàng tóu jiāng bāng zhù wǒ qīng chu de kàn dào nín de lán wěi bìng jìn xíng qiē chú zhěng ge shǒu shù dà yuē xū yào yí ge xiǎo shí
sentences.english: Next, I will make an incision in your abdomen in order to insert the surgical instruments and camera.
The camera will help me clearly see your appendix and carry out the removal. The entire surgery will take about an hour.

sentences.traditional: 患者：好的，我什麼時候手術比較好？
sentences.pinyin: huàn zhě hǎo de wǒ shén me shí hou shǒu shù bǐ jiào hǎo

sentences.english: Patient: Okay, when is the best time for my surgery?

sentences.simplified: 医生：越快越好。
sentences.traditional: 醫生：越快越好。
sentences.pinyin: yī shēng yuè kuài yuè hǎo

sentences.english: Doctor: The sooner the better.

sentences.simplified: 明天就可以安排。
sentences.traditional: 明天就可以安排。
sentences.pinyin: míng tiān jiù kě yǐ ān pái
sentences.english: Based on the results of your blood test and imaging, your physical condition is suitable for the surgery.
We can schedule it for tomorrow.

sentences.simplified: 患者：好的。我需要住院吗？
sentences.traditional: 患者：好的。我需要住院嗎？
sentences.pinyin: huàn zhě hǎo de wǒ xū yào zhù yuàn ma

sentences.english: Patient: Okay, do I need to stay in the hospital?

sentences.simplified: 医生：要住院，
sentences.traditional: 醫生：要住院，
sentences.pinyin: yī shēng yào zhù yuàn

sentences.simplified: 虽然阑尾炎手术的风险比较低，不过有一些患者会出现麻醉反应或者术后感染。
sentences.traditional: 雖然闌尾炎手術的風險比較低，不過有一些患者會出現麻醉反應或者術後感染。
sentences.pinyin: suī rán lán wěi yán shǒu shù de fēng xiǎn bǐ jiào dī bú guò yǒu yì xiē huàn zhě huì chū xiàn má zuì fǎn yìng huò zhě shù hòu gǎn rǎn
sentences.english: Doctor: You will need to stay in the hospital.

sentences.simplified: 你最好在医院观察两天，如果没有其他问题就可以出院了。
sentences.traditional: 你最好在醫院觀察兩天，如果沒有其他問題就可以出院了。
sentences.pinyin: nǐ zuì hǎo zài yī yuàn guān chá liǎng tiān rú guǒ méi yǒu qí tā wèn tí jiù kě yǐ chū yuàn le
sentences.english: Although the risk of an appendectomy is relatively low, some patients will have reactions to anesthesia or post-operative infections.
It’s best if you stay in the hospital for two days for observation. If there are no other issues, you can be discharged.

sentences.simplified: 患者：好的，我请我的家人来陪我。
sentences.traditional: 患者：好的，我請我的家人來陪我。
sentences.pinyin: huàn zhě hǎo de wǒ qǐng wǒ de jiā rén lái péi wǒ

sentences.english: Patient: Okay, I will ask my family to accompany me.

sentences.simplified: 医生：可以，你们先去办理一下住院手续，
sentences.traditional: 醫生：可以，你們先去辦理一下住院手續，
sentences.pinyin: yī shēng kě yǐ nǐ men xiān qù bàn lǐ yí xià zhù yuàn shǒu xù

sentences.simplified: 今天晚上九点以后就不要吃东西和喝水了。
sentences.traditional: 今天晚上九點以後就不要吃東西和喝水了。
sentences.pinyin: jīn tiān wǎn shang jiǔ diǎn yǐ hòu jiù bú yào chī dōng xi hé hē shuǐ le
sentences.english: Doctor: Okay, please complete the hospital admission procedures first.
After 9 o’clock tonight, please refrain from eating or drinking anything.

sentences.simplified: 患者：还有其他需要注意的事情吗？
sentences.traditional: 患者：還有其他需要注意的事情嗎？
sentences.pinyin: huàn zhě hái yǒu qí tā xū yào zhù yì de shì qing ma

sentences.english: Patient: Is there anything else I need to be aware of?

sentences.simplified: 医生：可以让家人给你准备一些液体的食物。
sentences.traditional: 醫生：可以讓家人給你準備一些液體的食物。
sentences.pinyin: yī shēng kě yǐ ràng jiā rén gěi nǐ zhǔn bèi yì xiē yè tǐ de shí wù

sentences.simplified: 术后的一两天内要卧床休息，少吃东西，吃点儿液体食物保持体力就可以了。
sentences.traditional: 術後的一兩天內要臥床休息，少吃東西，吃點兒液體食物保持體力就可以了。
sentences.pinyin: shù hòu de yì liǎng tiān nèi yào wò chuáng xiū xi shǎo chī dōng xi chī diǎn'r yè tǐ shí wù bǎo chí tǐ lì jiù kě yǐ le
sentences.english: Doctor: Your family can prepare some liquid foods for you.

sentences.simplified: 之后的几天不要剧烈运动，防止手术的伤口裂开。
sentences.traditional: 之後的幾天不要劇烈運動，防止手術的傷口裂開。
sentences.pinyin: zhī hòu de jǐ tiān bú yào jù liè yùn dòng fáng zhǐ shǒu shù de shāng kǒu liè kāi
sentences.english: After the surgery, you should rest in bed for a day or two, eat less, and consume some liquid foods to maintain your energy.

sentences.simplified: 然后需要保持伤口干燥，定期消毒就可以了。
sentences.traditional: 然後需要保持傷口乾燥，定期消毒就可以了。
sentences.pinyin: rán hòu xū yào bǎo chí shāng kǒu gān zào dìng qī xiāo dú jiù kě yǐ le
sentences.english: Don’t engage in vigorous exercise for a few days after the operation to prevent the surgical wound from splitting open.
Then, make sure you keep the wound dry and disinfect regularly, and you will be fine.

sentences.simplified: 患者：好的，谢谢您。我先去办住院手续了。
sentences.traditional: 患者：好的，謝謝您。我先去辦住院手續了。
sentences.pinyin: huàn zhě hǎo de xiè xie nín wǒ xiān qù bàn zhù yuàn shǒu xù le

sentences.english: Patient: Okay, thank you. I’ll complete the hospital admission procedures now.

sentences.simplified: 医生：好的！
sentences.traditional: 醫生：好的！

sentence_translations: Appendectomy
Doctor: Based on your current condition, I can confirm the diagnosis of appendicitis.
I recommend you to undergo surgery to remove the inflamed part.
Patient: Do I need surgery? Doctor, I’m very nervous because I’ve never had surgery before.
Doctor: I understand your anxiety. Surgery is indeed an significant matter.
You will be undergoing an appendectomy, which is a routine procedure and is technically very mature.
Patient: Can you explain the surgery procedure?
Doctor: Of course I can.
At the start of the surgery, the anesthetist will administer general anesthesia.
After anesthesia, you will not feel anything during the entire surgery process.
Next, I will make an incision in your abdomen in order to insert the surgical instruments and camera.
The camera will help me clearly see your appendix and carry out the removal. The entire surgery will take about an hour.
Patient: Okay, when is the best time for my surgery?
Doctor: The sooner the better.
Based on the results of your blood test and imaging, your physical condition is suitable for the surgery.
We can schedule it for tomorrow.
Patient: Okay, do I need to stay in the hospital?
Doctor: You will need to stay in the hospital.
Although the risk of an appendectomy is relatively low, some patients will have reactions to anesthesia or post-operative infections.
It’s best if you stay in the hospital for two days for observation. If there are no other issues, you can be discharged.
Patient: Okay, I will ask my family to accompany me.
Doctor: Okay, please complete the hospital admission procedures first.
After 9 o’clock tonight, please refrain from eating or drinking anything.
Patient: Is there anything else I need to be aware of?
Doctor: Your family can prepare some liquid foods for you.
After the surgery, you should rest in bed for a day or two, eat less, and consume some liquid foods to maintain your energy.
Don’t engage in vigorous exercise for a few days after the operation to prevent the surgical wound from splitting open.
Then, make sure you keep the wound dry and disinfect regularly, and you will be fine.
Patient: Okay, thank you. I’ll complete the hospital admission procedures now.
Doctor: Okay!
